summary: Verified both fixes are in place in source and built output: (1) --cwd is completely absent from cli-worker.ts and dist/cli-worker.js — cwd is handled at spawn time via runCliProcess options, (2) manual-tests.ts catches LLM/auth errors and calls buildFallbackTests() to return useful step-derived tests instead of throwing. Full e2e CLI test cannot run from within a Claude Code session (nested session detection), and systemctl restart is in the hard deny list. Operator will verify buttons manually after gateway restart.
